thread.title: Apple to issue fix for iPhones, Macs at risk from 'Spectre' chip flaw

author: Reuters
title: Apple to issue fix for iPhones, Macs at risk from 'Spectre' chip flaw
text: (Reuters) - Apple Inc (AAPL.O) will release a patch for the Safari web browser on its iPhones, iPads and Macs within days, it said on Thursday, after major chipmakers disclosed flaws that leave nearly every modern computing device vulnerable to hackers. On Wednesday, Alphabet Inc’s (GOOGL.O) Google and other security researchers disclosed two major chip flaws, one called Meltdown affecting only Intel Corp (INTC.O) chips and one called Spectre affecting nearly all computer chips made in the last ..
